dedupe_keys.name: reseau routier departemental de l herault

description: Réseau routier départemental de l'Hérault is a dataset listed in Hérault Data open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Conseil Départemental de l'Hérault. Tracé du réseau routier du département de l'Hérault. Géométrie en partie basée sur la BDTopo de l'IGN, Liste des principales étapes:Ajout du tracé en suivant les traces GPS des relevés vidéos, en cas d'écart de tracé significatif entre le terrain et les supports cartographiques (BDTOPO, BDOrtho)Calage sur le centre de la voie (Orthophoto), modélisation des ... Coverage: Hérault. The portal files it under Routes, Transports et Mobilités. Its keywords are insfrastructure-routiere, réseau routier, routes. The portal shows 27,360 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-herault-data-fr-portal.
